pathways.name: Study permit
pathways.summary: Study at a designated learning institution in Canada.

requirements.fixHint: Show more savings or add a financial sponsor
requirements.label: Proof of funds for one year of living costs (single applicant, excludes tuition and travel)

pathways.name: Post-graduation work permit (PGWP)
pathways.summary: Open work permit for graduates of eligible Canadian programs.

requirements.fixHint: Take or retake an approved English test
requirements.label: English CLB 7 in all four skills (university programs; CLB 5 for college programs)

pathways.name: Express Entry (Federal Skilled Worker)
pathways.summary: Points-ranked route to permanent residence for skilled workers.

requirements.fixHint: Retake IELTS General Training or CELPIP
requirements.label: English CLB 7 in all four skills
At least 1 year of continuous skilled work (TEER 0–3) in the last 10 years
Education credential (foreign credentials need an ECA)
Settlement funds (single applicant; not needed with a valid job offer)

requirements.fixHint: Gain Canadian work experience, e.g. through study and a PGWP
requirements.label: Recent draws favour Canadian experience
